text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A new heroine is born!!! Almond Eye 
unleashes her monstrous kick—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought! What a great 
feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of burst was that...! I was 
sure Lucky Lilac had it in the bag, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"This is a Classic race, you know? And 
yet, there's one girl who's just—in a 
whole different league..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah... Haah... ha...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ……! What the heck……—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaaa...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: What the heck was that finishing kick...?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I haven't let my guard down one bit... I 
know how she runs, and I prepared 
countermeasures... And yet...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—If she can unleash a burst of speed like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thanks to you, I was able to 
give it my best.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Ai-san. You truly 
showed me your strength.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you think so? Next—it's your 
turn!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're not done yet, are you? You're going 
to get—even stronger, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......Hoho. Can I take that... as a little 
pep talk for me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not trying to spur you on! I truly 
mean it from the bottom of my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
………… I'm not sure if I can live up to your 
expectations, but—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The next Oaks. I will polish my skills 
even further and take my revenge.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—There's still... there's still the 
brilliance of the Double Tiara.

Almond Eye finally returned. Giving brief 
words of praise, I iced her legs. All the 
while, she talked about what happened 
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I want to head to the Japanese 
Oaks next!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is 2400m. With the distance 
changing, you'll need a different kind of 
strength, right?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Lala will show us a different 
kind of strength... And I want to beat 
that Lala too! What do you think?
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's move on to the Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks)!

text_block_list.text:
I nodded, amazed at how utterly relentless 
Almond Eye became when directing her "will 
to win" at an opponent. Lucky Lilac must 
have been just as shocked.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's settled! ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Are you feeling unwell?
Are you okay? Are you feeling unwell...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm totally fine! It's well within 
what I can handle.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
GⅠ races truly are something else. I 
thought I'd be fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The sheer drive of the other girls betting 
on a "once-in-a-lifetime" chance... and 
the fever pitch of the crowd. You just end 
up absorbing it all, don't you?
choice_data_list:
Still, you kept your cool and finished 
strong. Congratulations!

Still, you kept your cool and finished 
strong. Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Standing in the Winner's 
Circle... it felt absolutely 
incredible...!

I ponder as we talk. Our next goal has 
been set as the "Oaks." It's a wonderful 
race steeped in history, but—
choice_data_list:
(If it's Ai, she could even win the Japan 
Derby...)

text_block_list.text:
"—Held right after the Oaks is the dream 
of everyone in racing... the Japanese 
Derby. Even with the strongest of the 
generation gathered, she would—"
choice_data_list:
(...Just kidding. Let's focus on Ai's 
dream!)

text_block_list.text:
Having finished all preparations and press 
conferences, upon returning to Tracen 
Academy—
(VROOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yo. —I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh, Vodka-chan!

Her name is Vodka. One of the great 
Umamusume who claimed seven turf GⅠ 
victories. Yet, her most magnificent 
achievement of all was—

As an Umamusume hailing from the Tiara 
route, she won the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby) for the first time in 64 years. 
—She overturned the common sense of the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "I saw the Oka Sho. ...Congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That was something else, those legs of 
yours. Honestly... it sent shivers down my 
spine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I will say this. Eye. —Enter 
the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling trapped by the Tiara's 
boundaries, stop obsessing over it. I 
smashed those to pieces long ago.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I know you can shatter common sense to 
pieces. Just like me!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The dream of being the strongest of your 
generation... You wanna seize it with 
those legs of yours, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —It doesn't matter if you can't reach it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right? Back then, I was also—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your advice, but I'm sorry. 
I'm going to run in the Yushun Himba!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, waait...!? No, you need to think 
about this more carefully!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"My bad. Turns out I'm running in the 
Derby after all." ...Come on, doesn't that 
sound super cool!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're right, you looked so cool! Winning 
the Japanese Derby is quite an honor too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If I could run, I'd want to run too! 
...Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There's someone I desperately want to 
beat. I want to race her even more!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I see. So you—are choosing that side, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Forget everything I just said. Pave 
your own path ahead."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Almond Eye. ...Hit me with 
everything you've got.

Vodka walks away into the sunset... 
pushing a motorcycle with its engine off. 
Why she came with a bike she can't even 
ride remains a mystery, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes—
